name: TIP Product Slider
author: alexvtn

sections.description:
TIP Product Slider is designed for WooCommerce store owners, marketers, agencies, developers, and WordPress site owners who want to display products in a more engaging and flexible way.

The plugin helps you create responsive product sliders for featured products, sale products, best sellers, new arrivals, specific categories, product tags, selected products, and custom WooCommerce product selections.

It is useful when you want to:

  • Highlight selected products on landing pages.
  • Promote sale products or seasonal collections.
  • Display featured, free, top-rated, or in-stock products.
  • Create product carousels for homepages, shop sections, blog posts, and promotional pages.
  • Show different product sliders across multiple areas of the same website.
  • Customize the product layout, carousel behavior, and visible product information.

Each product slider can be customized from the admin area and added to your website through a shortcode.

You can control the slider template, number of products, product filters, ordering, visible product details, responsive columns, autoplay, navigation arrows, pagination dots, spacing, transition speed, and button styles.

Product sliders can be reused across multiple pages using the generated shortcode, while shortcode parameters can also be configured manually when you need to override specific settings for a single placement.

Premium features

PRO templates
You can use 4 additional premium templates.

Advanced product filters
Filter products with advanced options such as specific product selection, product tag filters, sale products, featured products, free products, and in-stock products.

Sale percentage badge
Display the discount percentage in the sale badge.

Excerpt length control
Set how many words to display when the short description is enabled.

Advanced carousel controls
Customize product slider behavior with content visibility controls, product ordering options, responsive columns, responsive slides-to-scroll settings, and arrow or dot navigation controls.

Shortcode generator in the TinyMCE editor
Simplify the process of inserting product sliders by using the built-in shortcode generator. This tool lets you manually configure a slider and generate the shortcode needed to add it inside your WordPress content.

Gutenberg block
Add saved or custom product sliders from the block editor and preview them while editing the page.

Elementor widget
Build product sliders in Elementor using either a saved slider preset or an inline slider builder widget.

You can get the premium version from the link below:
https://www.themeinprogress.com/tip-product-slider-pro

You can see an example of all templates from the link below:
https://demo.themeinprogress.eu/tip-product-slider-pro/documentation-pro-version/templates/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin from the WordPress Plugins screen.
  3. Open the TIP Product Slider panel to create and manage timers.
